_comment: Which franchises call a LAN event's city home, keyed '<season year>:<event
name>'. Hand-curated, because no source carries it: LPDB's team.locations
holds region1 for 457 of 458 teams and a tournament's organizers field is
'Activision' for every Call of Duty League event.
The question asked is home MARKET, not designated host. Which franchise
signed the venue lease is not in the record and a Los Angeles weekend had
two Los Angeles teams, so 'whose city is this' is answerable from the venue
and the season's franchise list while 'who hosted' is not.
'teams' names franchises as they were branded that season, so a brand that
moved is not credited with a market it had not moved to yet. An empty list
is a neutral site and is stated rather than left out. 'confidence' is
'clear' where the venue is in the franchise's own city and 'judgement'
where it is elsewhere in the same metropolitan area; the host finding is
reported both with and without the judgement calls.
Only the Call of Duty League is listed. The CWL era was an open circuit of
org-branded teams — FaZe, OpTic, eUnited — with no home cities at all, so
every CWL event is a neutral site by construction rather than by omission.
